title: Apps
description: Mini apps your socios build, each on its own address behind your sign-in. An ephemeral app runs only while its socio’s computer runs it; once the socio packages it, promote it into a workspace app that runs on its own, with its data in your data space.

not-set-up.title: Mini apps are not set up
not-set-up.description: An operator sets APPS_HOST (and a wildcard DNS entry and proxy host for it) to serve mini apps. See docs/SETUP.md.

empty.title: No apps yet
empty.description: Ask a socio to build you a small app (a tracker, a dashboard, a form). It runs it in its computer and registers it here once you approve.

health.recovering: Recovering by itself; its data is kept.

health.gave-up_one: Automatic repair gave up after {{count}} attempt; admins were told. Its data is kept; press Start to try again.
health.gave-up_other: Automatic repair gave up after {{count}} attempts; admins were told. Its data is kept; press Start to try again.

others.title: Other apps in the workspace
others.description: Shown to admins by name and owner. Only the owner and the people of the Space it’s shared with can open one.
